title: mention_extract_request_v1
description: What may be sent to the extraction gateway. An allowlist, not a deny-list: additionalProperties is false everywhere, so a user id, an observation id, an email address or a calendar payload is refused because it was never permitted rather than because somebody remembered to name it. The failure mode of a deny-list is silence. Every bound here is authored in terms.xlsx under llm.input.* and llm.batch.*, and the compiler refuses to compile if the two disagree.

source_profile.description: Which source's predicate profile applies. Not the source's data.

items.description: Two at most, matching items.maxItems in the response schema. Raising it is a schema version change on both sides at once, which is the point of stating it twice and checking it once.

opaque_id.description: Compact and opaque. It correlates a response with a request and must carry nothing about whose request it is: no account id, no observation id, no email. The pattern bounds the shape; that it stays meaningless is the caller's obligation and the reason invocation lineage is keyed separately in the database rather than here.

source_action.description: The exact observed provider action beneath this item — liked_video, library_song, subscription, followed — so the model knows what kind of fact it is reading (three-lane contract 8.1: input MUST include the exact observed action). Optional for wire compatibility with requests built before it existed; the worker always sends it.

fields.description: The source fields the response schema's source_field enum names, and nothing else. A field the model cannot cite in an offset has no business being sent. performer, composer and album are the music lane's stated context — Apple states them on the row — and are what lets a song nominate its film, its franchise or its artist instead of standing alone.
